spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID (Dense, Data-heavy)
spacing_and_layout.padding_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8 for standard components. Containers with borders MUST use p-6 internal padding.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm (max 4px). Sharp, brutalist edges.

surface_strategies.header: Crystal Glass - backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/60, 1px bottom border border-white/10.
surface_strategies.cards: Flat background (#0F0F13), 1px solid border (rgba(255,255,255,0.12)), no shadow by default. Hover: border-white/30 and subtle shadow.
surface_strategies.active_incidents: Grid Borders pattern. Expose the skeleton. Use Tracing Beam effect for critical active incidents.
surface_strategies.buttons: Neumorphism mix (sharp 1px border) with stark contrast. Primary action (Apply/Rollback) uses accent colors strictly. Normal actions are flat grey.

rules.cards: Go cardless or rectangular/dense styles. Overuse of standard rounded cards is forbidden.
rules.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog, stripped of Vercel-look. Apply sharp borders, backdrop-blur on overlay.
rules.forms: Use Shadcn inputs. No native HTML inputs. Explicit focus states: focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent_primary focus:border-accent_primary.
rules.tables: Dense, technical tables. Use mono_font for all numerical/symbol data.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. e.g., hover:bg-[#1A1A24] hover:text-white.
motion_and_interaction.transitions: Use specific properties: transition: transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease.
motion_and_interaction.micro_interactions: Progress bars for cooldowns/rate limits. Status loaders for 'dry-run' and 'simulation' actions.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, links, forms, tabs) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute using kebab-case role-based naming. Example: data-testid='approve-live-action-button'.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Text over backgrounds MUST meet APCA/WCAG AA standards. Interactive elements must have 3:1 contrast against adjacent colors.

login_background.description: Abstract dark geometric futuristic pattern. Use as full-screen background for global auth/login with 50% opacity black overlay.

auth_session.layout: Centered stark login/reconnect terminal. Use login_background image. Clear session/device connection status.
auth_session.function: Must support websocket reconnect visualization (terminal logs style) to address 'preview admin login timeout' and 'auth loss' bugs.

unified_control_room.layout: Single-page mega-dashboard. 4 major zones: Live Operations, Learning & Adaptation, Risk & Market Context, Action Center.
unified_control_room.live_operations: List active incidents. Use Signal Red/Warning Yellow borders.
unified_control_room.learning_and_adaptation: List actionable recommendations and decay/drift metrics.
unified_control_room.risk_context: Recharts visual area showing cluster risk and tail risk.
unified_control_room.action_center: Fixed bottom/side panel for preview, approve, reject, apply, rollback.

explainability_cards.design: Data-heavy nested components. Use JetBrains Mono for 'before_state', 'after_state', 'incident_ref'. Include clear visual diffing (red for removed/before, green for added/after).

live_action_guardrails.design: Visual 'locks' on buttons. 'Dry Run' must be visually distinct from 'Live Apply' (e.g., dry run is outline button, live apply is solid). Show cooldown timers.

instructions_to_main_agent: NOTE: The frontend project uses .js/.jsx files, NOT .tsx. Provide and implement code strictly in JS/JSX.
Implement the Unified Control Room as a highly dense, tactical 'Command Center' using the specified MODE B grid strategy.
Ensure global auth stability and shared audit logging is integrated into all actions (Learning, Incident, Execution).
Integrate 'data-testid' aggressively on all action buttons (approve, reject, rollback, dry-run).
Do NOT use HTML inputs or selects; strictly use customized shadcn components (adjust shadcn component files to be .js/.jsx).
Build the Human-in-the-loop policy engine UI (Controlled Auto-Apply) showing confidence, impact, decay, and sample coverage metrics.
Construct the Production Readiness Checklist as a clear, un-bypassable modal/screen before Stage Activation.
